About this item

【2000W Dual Motor 】- The E26 Pro dual motor electric bikes have two brushless motors with a total power output of 2000W, allowing them to reach a top speed of 28+++ mph and conquer 45° hills. With the Shamano 7-speed gear system, tackling steep inclines becomes effortless, giving you the confidence to explore.
【23AH Large Battery & 87 Miles Long Range】- Dual motor eBike with UL certified 48V 23Ah removable battery, Pure electric range 50-75km, assisted range 70-90km. Ideal for commuting and mountain adventures. Enjoy instant relaxation with every ride.
【Full Suspension & Hydraulic Dual Brakes】- 100% reinforced front suspension fork for improved maneuverability on rough terrains. Superior performance with rear hydraulic shock absorber. Hydraulic dual brakes reduce braking distance by 50%. 26 x 4.0'' fat tires enhance riding stability on all terrains.
【Powerful Electric Bike】- Versatile electric bicycle with pure electric, pedal-assist, and classic bike modes. Perfect for commuting or exploring trails with exercise and relaxation in mind. An excellent choice for various scenarios.
【Easy & Safe Riding】 - Advanced LCD display shows real-time metrics, adjustable parameters, and trip tracking. Features bright LED headlights and IP5 waterproof protection for safe riding in various road conditions. Maximum load capacity of 330 lbs for the 2000W electric bike.
【Unique Style & Sports Vision】 - Imaginatively designed 2000W electric bike with a cool headlight for night safety. Delicate and comfortable saddle supported by a reinforced pole and hollowed-out bracket, offering an exhilarating sports adventure experience. Get ready to make a fashion statement and leave others envious with this adult electric bicycle, embracing the latest trend!

[One-Year Warranty] - Established in New Jersey and proudly serving the US since 2008. Our products come 90% pre-assembled and include a 1-year warranty on the motor, battery, and charger. For any inquiries, feel free to reach out, and we'll get back to you within 24 hours. //Please keep the original packaging for a period of time.

Product Description

Gear up for summer adventures with our dual-motor 2000W electric mountain bike

Unleash your adventurous spirit with our dual-motor 2000W electric bike.
Conquer steep slopes effortlessly with unmatched climbing power. Experience the thrill of speed and control as you explore diverse landscapes.
Elevate your outdoor excursions like never before!

Super Bright Headlight and Brake Light
Ride confidently during nighttime adventures with our electric bike's waterproof headlights and brake lights. Stay safe and enjoy clear visibility, whether you're commuting after work or exploring dark trails.

Dual Hydraulic Disc Brakes
The rear hydraulic shock absorber offers superior performance over mechanical models. With hydraulic dual brakes, braking distance is reduced by 50%, ensuring a safer ride, even in wet conditions.

26"*4.0" Fat Tires
Our electric mountain bike is built to conquer any terrain with confidence. It features 26"*4.0" puncture-resistant fat tires that effortlessly handle various surfaces like grass, dirt, sand, snow, and gravel.

Twist Grip Throttle & Shamano7-Speed
Throttle twisting allows effortless speed control and improved safety. The Shimano 7-Speed system enables smooth and precise gear changes on different surfaces.

2000W Motor
Unleash the power of our E26 Pro dual motor electric bikes. With a combined 2000W output, they reach speeds of 28+++ mph and conquer 45° hills. Perfect for off-road adventures in rugged terrains.

Removable Battery
Go the distance with our e-bike's 48V 23Ah battery. In electric mode, it offers a range of 30 miles, and with pedal-assist, you can go up to 50 miles. The removable design allows for easy installation and removal of the battery.

Double Shock Absorption
Experience a smooth and comfortable ride with our e-bike's enhanced front and rear suspension forks. Our improved suspension system effectively absorbs bumps on rough roads, ensuring a more enjoyable ride.

LCD Colorful Display
Stay informed with our e-bike's LCD digital display. Track your speed, mileage, battery level, PAS, and other important information with ease and clear visibility.
